# Quiz Couple

> Quiz Couple is a free online platform offering 50+ relationship quizzes, tests and games for couples. Available in 5 languages (French, English, Spanish, German, Italian).

## Main Features

- Free couple compatibility tests (no registration required)
- Relationship health assessments
- Fun couple quizzes and games
- Astrology compatibility calculator
- Relationship blog with expert articles

## Quiz Categories

### Relationship Tests
- [Purity Test for Couples](https://quiz-couple.com/test-purete-couple/): 50 weighted questions on your past, lies, nights out and what you have done together, scored out of 899 with a breakdown by category. Solo or as a couple (FR)
- [Couple Compatibility Test](https://quiz-couple.com/en/couple-compatibility-test/): 20-question relationship strength assessment
- [Love Compatibility Test](https://quiz-couple.com/en/love-compatibility-test/): 20 questions answered by both partners on values, life plans and daily habits, with a compatibility percentage
- [Am I in Love Test](https://quiz-couple.com/en/am-i-in-love-test/): 20 questions to tell love from a crush, scored so that idealising someone counts for less than knowing them with their flaws
- [Karmic Relationship Test](https://quiz-couple.com/en/karmic-relationship-test/): typology test sorting your bond into karmic, mirror (twin flame) or peaceful (soulmate), with a psychological reading of the same signs
- [Toxic Relationship Test](https://quiz-couple.com/en/toxic-relationship-test/): Identify unhealthy relationship patterns
- [Is My Relationship Over?](https://quiz-couple.com/en/is-my-relationship-over-test/): 24 factual questions weighted by how serious each sign of an ending really is, from a vague feeling that something changed to a cancelled joint plan or the word separation being said, scored out of 152 across eight tiers
- [Love or Friendship?](https://quiz-couple.com/en/love-or-friendship-test/): 20 weighted questions to tell love apart from friendship, scoring only the signs that have no friendly explanation, such as jealousy over their dates or the word friend starting to ring false, scored out of 146 across six tiers
- [Narcissistic Partner Test](https://quiz-couple.com/en/narcissistic-partner-test/): 20 questions to spot narcissistic abuse, manipulation and gaslighting
- [Love or Habit Test](https://quiz-couple.com/en/love-or-habit-test/): 20 questions to tell whether you stay together out of love or habit
- [Healthy Relationship Test](https://quiz-couple.com/en/healthy-relationship-test/): Evaluate your couple's wellbeing
- [Marriage Compatibility Test](https://quiz-couple.com/en/marriage-compatibility-test/): Ready for marriage assessment
- [Should I Divorce Test](https://quiz-couple.com/en/should-i-divorce-test/): Decision guidance tool
- [Jealousy Test](https://quiz-couple.com/en/jealousy-test-couple/): Measure jealousy levels
- [Love Language Test](https://quiz-couple.com/en/love-language-test-couple/): Discover your love language
- [Attachment Style Test](https://quiz-couple.com/en/attachment-style-test/): Secure, anxious, avoidant or disorganised, based on Bowlby's attachment theory
- [Trust Test for Couples](https://quiz-couple.com/en/trust-test-couple/): 20 questions on jealousy, transparency and reliability in your relationship
- [Emotional Dependency Test](https://quiz-couple.com/en/emotional-dependency-test/): 20 questions to tell healthy attachment from emotional dependency, with four result levels
- [Infidelity Test](https://quiz-couple.com/en/infidelity-test-couple/): 20 questions on the warning signs of cheating, emotional and physical
- [Has He or She Slept With Someone Else](https://quiz-couple.com/en/has-he-she-slept-with-someone-else-test/): 15 questions focused on physical infidelity, with two question sets depending on the partner's gender
- [Does He or She Secretly Love Me](https://quiz-couple.com/en/does-he-she-secretly-love-me-test/): 10 questions on the signals of unspoken attraction, for a friend or colleague rather than a partner
- [Long Distance, Does He or She Still Love Me](https://quiz-couple.com/en/long-distance-does-he-she-still-love-me-test/): 15 solo questions separating distance fatigue from fading feelings
- [Long Distance Relationship Quiz](https://quiz-couple.com/en/long-distance-relationship-quiz/): Distance couple assessment
- [Common Points Test](https://quiz-couple.com/en/couple-common-points-test/): Find what you share
- [Parenthood Readiness Test](https://quiz-couple.com/en/parenthood-readiness-test/): Are you ready for a baby?
- [Ready for a Baby Test](https://quiz-couple.com/en/ready-for-a-baby-test/): 20 questions on emotional maturity, finances and lifestyle before starting a family
- [Moving In Together Test](https://quiz-couple.com/en/moving-in-together-test/): Should you move in together?
- [Does My Ex Still Think About Me](https://quiz-couple.com/en/does-my-ex-still-think-about-me/): 15 weighted questions on what an ex actually does rather than what you read into it, with two question sets depending on their gender and four result tiers
- [Mental Load Test for Couples](https://quiz-couple.com/en/mental-load-test-couples/): 20 household tasks rated on who thinks of them, not who does them, playable alone or by both partners, returning a split, a per-area breakdown and the gap between the two accounts
- [Soulmate Test](https://quiz-couple.com/en/soulmate-test/): 20 questions across four pillars (ease, deep agreement, hardship, autonomy), with an index and a verdict drawn from the shape of the profile; solo, duo or single mode
- [Love or Crush Test](https://quiz-couple.com/en/love-or-crush-test/): 35 weighted questions to tell a real feeling from a passing crush, with question sets adapted to the crush's gender

### Fun Quizzes
- [Love Quiz](https://quiz-couple.com/en/love-quiz/): Romantic debate questions
- [Spicy Couple Quiz](https://quiz-couple.com/en/spicy-couple-quiz/): Intimate guessing game
- [Funny Couple Quiz](https://quiz-couple.com/en/funny-couple-quiz/): Lighthearted discussion prompts
- [Who Knows Partner Best](https://quiz-couple.com/en/who-knows-partner-best-quiz/): Knowledge challenge
- [Who Is Most Likely Quiz](https://quiz-couple.com/en/who-is-most-likely-quiz/): Group voting game
- [Teen Couple Quiz](https://quiz-couple.com/en/teen-couple-quiz/): For young couples
- [Embarrassing Couple Quiz](https://quiz-couple.com/en/embarrassing-couple-quiz/): Awkward questions
- [True or False Quiz](https://quiz-couple.com/en/true-or-false-couple-quiz/): Relationship myths
- [Quiz Les Z'Amours](https://quiz-couple.com/quiz-couple-les-zamours/): Online version of the French TV show "Les Z'Amours", guess your partner's answers (FR)
- [Temptation Island Quiz](https://quiz-couple.com/en/temptation-island-quiz/): Unofficial quiz inspired by the Temptation Island format, with 12 days on the island, 30 tempting situations and a final bonfire verdict
- [First Date Questions Game](https://quiz-couple.com/en/first-date-questions-game/): 60 questions in three tiers of rising intimacy, 15 drawn per round and always played in order, for two people on one phone, with no score and no winner

### Couple Games
- [Couple Games Hub](https://quiz-couple.com/en/couple-games/): the eleven games to play together on a single phone, free and without an account
- [Would You Rather](https://quiz-couple.com/en/would-you-rather-couple-quiz/): 30 impossible dilemmas, each partner picks on their own, then you compare
- [Truth or Dare for Couples](https://quiz-couple.com/en/truth-or-dare-couple-game/): 70 cards in one deck, the player calls truth or dare, with a forfeit when a card is turned down
- [Dirty Truth or Dare](https://quiz-couple.com/en/dirty-truth-or-dare-couples/): 70 adults-only cards from suggestive to very direct, with the right to pass on every card
- [Couple Forfeit Wheel](https://quiz-couple.com/en/couple-forfeits-wheel/): a spinning wheel with eight slots and 140 forfeits, from a kiss to a confession, spun again as often as you like
- [Couple Board Game](https://quiz-couple.com/en/couple-board-game/): a 40-square board with a dice and two pawns, mixing truths, dares, duels, memories, forfeits and luck squares, with a winner at the finish
- [Which One of Us](https://quiz-couple.com/en/which-one-of-us-couple-game/): both partners vote in secret on the same question, the two answers are revealed together, and the game returns a harmony score over 12 rounds
- [Couple Dilemmas](https://quiz-couple.com/en/couple-dilemmas-game/): 100 take-it-or-leave-it deals, each pairing a prize with a catch; the couple answers OK or NOT OK and then sees how every other couple voted, with live vote counts and percentages on both sides
- [For or Against](https://quiz-couple.com/en/for-or-against-couple-game/): 60 statements a couple settles together, from what to eat tonight to buying a house, moving abroad, marriage and children; the pair answers FOR or AGAINST and then sees the split among all the other couples who voted
- [Never Have I Ever for Couples](https://quiz-couple.com/en/never-have-i-ever-couples-game/): 100 couple statements answered in turns on one phone, in rounds of 15, 30 or the full 100, with a pie-chart recap of both players' confessions
- [Who Could](https://quiz-couple.com/en/who-could-couples-game/): one question at a time above two big name buttons, you point at who could do it (or nobody), in rounds of 20, 40 or 60 drawn from 108 questions
- [Yes or No for Couples](https://quiz-couple.com/en/yes-or-no-couples-game/): 120 couple situations answered YES or NO together, with the live vote counts of every other visitor shown after each answer; no score and no finish line

### Other Tools
- [Couple Questions](https://quiz-couple.com/en/couple-questions/): 200+ conversation starters
- [Zodiac Compatibility](https://quiz-couple.com/en/zodiac-signs-names-compatibility/): Astrology + first name analysis
- [Birth Date Love Compatibility](https://quiz-couple.com/en/birth-date-love-compatibility/): Two birth dates crossed through three readings, numerology life path, sun sign and Chinese zodiac with the real lunar new year dates
- [Couple Activities Near Me](https://quiz-couple.com/en/couple-activities-near-me/): Date ideas by location
- [Où partir en vacances en couple](https://quiz-couple.com/test-ou-partir-en-vacances/): questionnaire matching your answers against 244 destinations with budget, season and travel style (FR)
